status: User accepted 1 exact diagnostic sites on 2026-10-07. Focused qualification and its limits are unchanged; full RPM/native ARM gates remain open.

diagnostics.diagnostic: ../deps/v8/src/wasm/wasm-objects.cc:1240:55: warning: ‘*(long unsigned int*)((char*)&result_inplace + offsetof(std::optional<long unsigned int>,std::optional<long unsigned int>::<unnamed>.std::_Optional_base<long unsigned int, true, true>::<unnamed>))’ may be used uninitialized [-Wmaybe-uninitialized]

root_cause: GCC does not preserve the relationship between the repeated shared-buffer query, must_grow_in_place and the early return when the optional result is empty.
source_review: JSArrayBuffer::Setup initializes the shared flag. It does not change while this existing buffer is read by Grow.
A shared buffer makes must_grow_in_place true. An empty result returns -1 (or terminates in correctness-fuzzer mode) before the shared branch reads the optional.

BackingStore::GrowWasmMemoryInPlace returns the successful compare-exchange’s previous length, not the earlier unsynchronized length. The shared branch correctly returns that value and permits subsequent worker growth before the broadcast-length check.

coverage.matrix: Memory32/64, explicit/implicit maxima, zero and boundary sizes, shared/guarded/resizable modes, moving stress, injected growth failure and modeled concurrent growth before/after the atomic result. Release/debug normally and under Valgrind.
coverage.memory: Both qualified runs have zero errors and all allocations freed.
coverage.compiler: Release and debug controls both reproduce the optional payload warning.
coverage.actual: One, two and four workers grow the same Wasm memory. Positive growth returns each prior page count exactly once; zero growth, maximum rejection and data preservation pass. Unshared growth detaches the old buffer and rejects excess growth.

limits: The original Grow prefix through the shared return is verbatim. Typed handles, buffers and backing stores model allocation results and interleavings; they do not allocate virtual memory or implement V8’s atomic primitive.
The native control marks continuation into the unshared tail with -2; it makes no claim that this is a real Grow result. Actual Node separately tests the unshared path.
Concurrent increments in the native model are deterministic injected states. Actual JavaScript worker tests exercise real concurrent growth without sleeps or polling.

The correctness-fuzzer fatal branch is retained and reviewed but not executed by this control. Native fault injection also includes an empty result for zero-page growth to test the guard, although real zero-page growth succeeds.
No runtime patch, suppression or compiler-flag change is proposed.
